templates.text: A whiff of milk formula → a faint, slow head turn, then stillness.
Sudden scent of antiseptic → a weak grimace, a shallow breath, no cry.
Mother's distant perfume → a brief, drowsy sniffing motion that trails off.
Odor of a soiled diaper → a slight squirm, then a return to limp sleep.
Faint smell of alcohol swab → delayed eyelid flutter, mouth opens slightly.
Scent of warm blanket → a slow, partial rooting motion that lacks direction.
Pungent adult body odor → a muted startle, followed by apathetic stillness.
Aroma of breast milk → a sluggish attempt to suck, mouth falls slack.
Sharp smell of vinegar → a wrinkled nose, a weak turn away, then no further reaction.
Fragrance of baby lotion → a slow hand brings to face, drops after {seconds} seconds.
Musty scent of old cloth → a shallow sigh, limbs remain flaccid.
Sweet scent of fruit → eyes open briefly, close before a orienting response completes.
Acrid smell of smoke → a feeble cough, then respiratory effort diminishes.
Odor of sweaty hand → a weak head aversion, movement ceases midway.
Clean scent of soap → a slow blink, a faint sigh, no alerting.
Sour milk smell → a grimace forms slowly, dissolves into neutral expression.
Earthy smell of soil → a brief increase in respiratory rate, then returns to baseline.
Metallic hospital scent → a delayed, minimal limb retraction, then flaccidity.
Scent of vanilla → a subtle stirring, a half-formed suck, then lapse.
Strong floral perfume → a weak sneeze, followed by unresponsive lethargy.
Odor of cooked food → a slow mouthing motion, no salivation or search.
Rancid butter smell → a faint gag reflex triggered, but swallowing is absent.
Fresh linen scent → a slow arm extension, drops limply after {seconds} second.
Pungent cheese odor → a slight arching of the back, immediately subsides.
Mild scent of honey → a drowsy smacking of lips once, then silence.
Chemical cleaner smell → eyes squeeze shut slowly, reopen with glassy stare.
Odor of damp wool → a shallow, rapid breath cycle that quickly fatigues.
Scent of paternal cologne → a slow head turn toward source, loses track.
Bitter almond aroma → a weak tongue protrusion, no full aversive response.
Warm bread smell → a partial rooting reflex initiated but not sustained.
